dedupe_keys.name: odit ensemble des surfaces de routes de la zone d etude en 1984

description: ODIT - Ensemble des surfaces de routes de la zone d'étude en 1984 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer represents the road surfaces (square, junction, toll, parking) of the study area in 1984. It was obtained by photo-interpretation from aerial photographs of the IGN dating from 1984 and 1985. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "ODIT - All road surfaces in the study area in 1984" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Franche-Comté, Besançon, Usage des sols, 1984, France. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
